title: Traditional German Sausage Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with traditional german sausage, perfect for a cold winter's day. This stew is gluten-free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Brown the sausage in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil to the pot if necessary and cook the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the stew beef and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, potatoes, carrots, and browned sausage to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
